description: The line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores for four different models—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—across varying values of the hyperparameter log r, which ranges from 0 to 8 on a linear scale. The y-axis represents the ROUGE-1 score, with values ranging from 0 to 35. The T5 + LoRA model (red line with circular markers) shows a relatively stable performance, with scores fluctuating between approximately 24 and 25. The MBart + LoRA model (purple line with circular markers) exhibits a more dynamic trend, starting at a low score of around 5, peaking at approximately 23, and then declining to about 24. The T5 + AdaLoRA model (green line with circular markers) demonstrates a consistent increase in ROUGE-1 scores, starting at around 24 and rising to approximately 31. The MBart + AdaLoRA model (orange line with circular markers) shows a significant increase, starting at around 5 and rising sharply to a plateau of about 34. Overall, the MBart + AdaLoRA model achieves the highest ROUGE-1 scores across most values of log r, while the T5 + LoRA model maintains a steady but lower performance.
